items.title: the "I'm So Sorry" costume carousel
items.body: a 4–5 photo halloween costume post where the last slide shows how it actually turned out. the reveal is always the best part.

items.title: a "Purple Rain" guitar clip blew up
items.body: a guitar cover clip of Prince's "Purple Rain" went from about 152K videos to 434K+ in a couple weeks. it's under literally everything rn.

items.title: "AI vs. handmade" dance
items.body: people post an AI-made version and a real version of the same "Dame Hombro" dance side by side. the dembow song is spreading from latin creators in the US to spain and italy.

items.title: the Christmas switch is ON
items.body: november 1 hit and everyone flipped from halloween straight to christmas content. it's been 2 days.

items.title: gen z says the mainstream is dead
items.body: most gen z in a big Mastercard study say there's no single shared pop culture anymore. everyone's in their own little corner of the internet.

items.title: 65% of gen z call themselves creators
items.body: same study: 65% of gen z identify as creators and think about building a personal brand. ok so everyone is the talent now.

items.title: tweens are taking screen breaks on purpose
items.body: 40% of 12- to 15-year-olds take breaks from screens as "digital self-care." honestly more disciplined than me.

items.title: gen alpha is "AI-native"
items.body: they're being called the first generation that grew up with AI from the start, chatbots, AR filters and avatars just part of normal life.
